title: Luna: build an offline editorial-evaluation smoke harness
description:
Implements LIM-81ecb1. Create the first deterministic evaluation slice for Limatus.

Scope:
- Define fixture manifest format for draft, portable profile, expected finding kinds, and option safety constraints.
- Implement a local runner with concise pass or fail output and nonzero status on expectation failures.
- Seed must-pass house voice and must-fail brochure fixtures from the existing corpus.

Gherkin outcome:
Given the checked-in eval corpus
When I run the offline eval command
Then it reports expected finding coverage and fails on a regression without network or an LLM.

Out of scope: LLM judges, acceptance telemetry, and CI publishing.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Started acceptance-first implementation. Building deterministic offline runner over checked-in corpus; no network/LLM dependencies.
